2769.title: Flat project skill roots skip containment
2769.rootCauseOneLine: The flat skill scanner opens a project root before it resolves and checks the root against the workspace boundary.
2769.proposedFix: Use the existing resolved-root containment policy for both flat and recursive project skill roots.
2769.caveats: The reproduction used the host-daemon discovery function directly. It did not start a live bb instance.
